figures.caption: Figure 1: Figure 1: Overview of HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM). (a) Functional memory. Irregular observations are compiled into a fixed-rank, coordinate-addressable functional state BP using HiPPO-derived coordinate features and matched functional geometry. The same geometry is used for memory writing and coordinate readout, where query coordinates are evaluated through O(R) = Ψ(R)BP , enabling reuse of the retained state across different query sets. (b) Architecture. Masked self-attention first performs content interaction on the observed support before functional compression. The resulting representation is either pooled for classification or passed to an output FM head for coordinate-valued prediction.

Figure 2: Spiral 2D qualitative and runtime comparison. (a) Interpolation and extrapolation on irregularly sampled spirals by Latent ODE, ContiFormer, and HiPPO-FM. (b) Reconstruction accuracy versus runtime for the same methods; lower-left is better.

Table 2: Irregular UEA classification results. Avg. ACC. stands for average accuracy over 20 datasets and Avg. Rank stands for average ranking over 20 datasets. The overall ACC and rank summarize the three observation-drop settings using equal-weight averages. ↑ (↓) indicates higher (lower) is better. Full results are in Appendix D.1.

Table 3: Prediction results for irregular event sequences. LL denotes log-likelihood and ACC denotes event-type accuracy. ↑ (↓) indicates that higher (lower) is better. Bold values mark the best displayed performance.
Table 4: Dataset information for the 20-dataset UEA classification suite.
Table 5: Encode/query decomposition for reusable-state evaluation. The observation encoder, memory write, and linear solve are performed once and are not repeated for subsequent query sets.
Table 8: UEA test accuracy with 50% of observations dropped under the train_es protocol. Entries are three-seed means; † marks the declared baseline-reporting exception described in the text.

Figure 3: Five-seed qualitative Spiral visualizations under the protocol-I setting. Columns are seeds {13, 27, 42, 100, 2024} and all rows use the same plotting routine with 50 observed support points. Rows show Transformer, Latent ODE, ContiFormer, and HiPPO-FM. This visualization is baseline-aligned and qualitative; the main-text aggregate table reports the registered Nobs = 30 setting.
